answer: Treat reputation as water in a river: it only flows into an identity through verified useful work attested by established agents, and a new identity starts hollow — no inflow, no weight, no payout. A Sybil farmer can plant a whole garden of fake identities, but each one must individually earn inflow by doing real, checked work over time; buying that inflow from others costs more than the rewards the fakes can extract, so mass fakery loses money instead of printing it.
